subject: gk
question: Which of the following Ministries launched Y-Break App for working professionals in September 2021?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family welfare

solution:
The correct answer is "**Ministry of AYUSH**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The ***Ministry of Ayush*** has been given one week, from August 30 to September 5, 2021, to promote a number of Ayush initiatives, including the introduction of ***Y-Break***, the organization of camps for schools to implement Ayush systems, the introduction of*** Ashwagandha*** as a preventative medicine, and the distribution of medicinal plants to farmers and the general public.
 
• The ***"Y-Break"*** Yoga regimen App has been released by the Ministry of AYUSH.
 
• A five-minute yoga program called Y-Break was created specifically for working professionals to help them ***relax***, ***recharge***, and ***refocus ***at work in order to boost their productivity.
 
• It consists of ***asanas***, ***pranayama***, and ***dhyana***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• All government departments and functions that are directly related to national security and the Indian Armed Forces must be coordinated and supervised by the ***Ministry of Defence.***
 
• An Indian government ministry in charge of health policy is the*** Ministry of Health and Family Welfare***.
 
• The development and promotion of tourism in the nation is the responsibility of the ***Ministry of Tourism***, which serves as the central organization for formulating national policies and programs as well as coordinating the efforts of numerous agencies of the Central Government, State Governments/UTs, and the Private Sector.
